About Aegis CyberWorks

Watch the video featured on the original About page

Your Partner for Cyber Security Solution

Aegis CyberWorks is a dynamic cybersecurity partner helping organizations across Africa and beyond build trust in their digital operations. Rooted in national CSIRT experience, we understand the realities of defending systems and data in complex, fast-evolving environments. We collaborate with companies, government institutions, and innovators in Kenya, Nigeria, Ghana, Cabo Verde, and Abu Dhabi, with more partnerships steadily growing across the continent. Our expertise spans security audits, digital forensics, anti-surveillance measures, secure systems design, and incident response capability development — all tailored to the needs of emerging markets. Our mission is to strengthen Africa’s digital resilience through collaboration, innovation, and solutions that meet global standards while addressing local realities.

Work Process

How We Work

Understand Your Needs

We engage with you to understand your objectives, challenges, and operating environment.

Assess & Analyze

We conduct structured assessments to identify gaps, risks, and opportunities.

Design the Solution

We develop a tailored, practical solution aligned with your business goals and international standards.

Implement & Execute

We deliver the agreed solution through a controlled, transparent implementation process.

Test & Validate

We verify effectiveness, performance, and compliance before final delivery.

Report & Handover

We provide clear documentation, reports, and knowledge transfer.

Support & Improve

We offer ongoing support and continuous improvement where required.
